beats.say: Harry Gilby has joined the cast as Charlie Weasley in the upcoming HBO series.
Jasper Talbot and Hannah Chinn are confirmed to play James and Lily Potter.
The first season premieres on HBO on Christmas Day.
Kit Harington will also join Season Two as Gilderoy Lockhart.
Variety notes Charlie Weasley was left out of the films entirely, making this his first screen appearance.
Harry Gilby starts the journey when the show arrives.
